notes.title: Update 0.6.0 - Public Lobbies, Single Player Mode and New Rules!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41229514/10edf868838c43f672e94a165ddec8cf789767c0.pngNew Features
[olist]
New Tutorial: Multiple missions to help explain the user interface and game rules

New Game Rules: Bounty Reward System
At the start of a players turn Masts can be converted into a payout. This can help boost essential action and allow for all ship attacks to be worth the pursuit.

Multiplayer: Game Lobbies can now be toggled to public and will show up when other players go to the join game screen

New Graphics: All (18) Faction Abilities have been animated
[/olist]

Improvements
[olist]
Game Detail window in the top right can be expanded to get more information on flag and island counts
Updated Battle Cry to new Rules
Updated Expedition to new Rules
Debris and Wreckage is now targetable
Improve Ship UI buttons and button flow
Added attack dice to all players in multiplayer games
Detect if no sails are available
Added attack dice interface to engineer's fortifications
Ships now sail around objects and not in straight lines
[/olist]


Bug Fixes
General

Fixed first attack breaking Attack dice interface
Fixed network targeting issues
Fixed Island Claim cost taking resource on a failed claim
Fixed firing after Free fire not showing target
Fixed Broadside calculation error
Fixed Stern/bow hit requirement
Fixed Ship UI buttons disabled after targeted ability
Fixed Broadside calculation failing a lack of line of sight
Fixed Attack pausing in multiplayer for pre-attack abilities
Removed Transcended ships moving through islands
Removed empty ability popup when player doesn't have enough gold

Abilities

Added Forgotten Retreat ability cost
Added Cursed coin affecting hit chances
Added Last Stand ships add wreckage
Fixed Non-Eternal ship freeze
Fixed Eternal Gateway destination issue
Fixed Range Expertise Ability UI
Fixed Raid ability cost calculation
Fixed Grappling Hook not being prompted
Fixed Last Stand not prompting from ability damage
Fixed Last Stand disappearing on Overkills
Fixed Last Stand UI issue
Fixed Last Stand not appearing on multiplayer
Fixed Battle Cry action range 1 to 2
Fixed Battle Cry trigger range
Fixed Storm Hit Requirement not updating on the same turn it is placed
Fixed Tradewinds breaking gateway ability
Fixed Bootlegger Raid ability reducing sail twice on the same ship
Fixed using Grappling Hook two times in a turn doesn't spawn the ability button
Fixed Ranged Expertise prompt issues
Fixed Salvage multiple popup failure
Fixed Elite mitigate ability overhealing
Fixed Salvage ability on multiplayer
Removed Grappling hook's ability to pull fortifications
Removed Cursed coin enabled on off-turns
 Removed Salvage enabled on off-turns

Visuals

Fixed visual offset issue on ship movement animations
Fixed left and right click breaking camera drag
Hit Requirement not displayed correctly through storms
Fixed Last Stand aura not appearing
Fixed Fortify animation
Fixed Battle Cry breaking turn system when activated during ship firing
Fixed Elite Formation visual issues
Fixed Particle animation issue with Retreat
Fixed Salvage animation starting from the wrong ship
Fixed damage popup not appearing above storms

AI Player

Fixed AI sometime sailing to the exact spot
Fixed AI first round taking two turns

notes.title: Update 0.4.0 - AI Player and Cross Platform Matches
notes.notes:
New Features

Cross-Platform Play
Android version publicly available
AI/Computer Player added to Matches


Improvements

Better touch detection
Gameplay hints can be toggled in options
New Match Connect UI
More battle logged info
Island Claim UI improved
Return fire is calculated better and can detect line of sight
Grappling Hook updated to new rules


Bugs

Fixed memory leak during networked matches
Fixed Barbarian ship Transcending during last stand (that was fun...)
Cursed Coin crashing on mobile
Hit Distance not matching from stern
Hit Distance not modified correctly from storm
Last Stand UI did not appear during networked match
Pierced target window did not correctly display hit distance
Ranged Expertise not limited by gold and not correctly appearing for marksman ships


Next Up

UI updates
More AI behavior 
Tutorial
Technical changes to prepare for Campaigns
